must: Preserve the exact five architecture stages and their responsibility copy.
Preserve the two semantic groups: Intent normalization and Code generation.
Use the existing muted mauve and brown palette.
Keep every option readable at the component lab's scaled preview size.
Treat the saved page component as a permanent no-slot control.
Query the live 21st catalog before creating every new creative-carousel batch and record the retrieved component lineage in each option.
avoid: Bright colors outside the established palette
Decorative changes that obscure stage-to-responsibility mapping
Rounded-pill styling for the table itself

decisions: The system notes component uses an overline heading and route-stepper controls.
Creative exploration happens in the local two-panel carousel lab and is only published after explicit selection.
Paired-page sections use a restrained scroll-linked entrance: the pages fade in from opposite sides and converge into a 12px overlap with mirrored 1.4 degree inward tilts.

On desktop, each major paired-page object and the workflow carousel pins within a finite native-scroll track while its entrance resolves, then releases naturally into the next section; reduced-motion and narrow layouts remain unpinned.
